name: folnaro
title: Folnaro
description: Search invoices, quotes and customers, track time and capture receipts in Folnaro, the invoicing app for freelancers in Germany.
author: folnaro

commands.name: search-folnaro
commands.title: Search Folnaro
commands.description: Find invoices, quotes, customers, expenses and projects in Folnaro.

commands.name: start-timer
commands.title: Start Timer
commands.subtitle: Folnaro
commands.description: Start the Folnaro timer for a project or customer, with your recent ones first.

commands.name: stop-timer
commands.title: Stop Timer
commands.subtitle: Folnaro
commands.description: Stop the running Folnaro timer and save the time entry.

commands.name: running-timer
commands.title: Running Timer
commands.subtitle: Folnaro
commands.description: Show the running Folnaro timer in the menu bar.

preferences.name: hideWhenIdle
preferences.title: Menu Bar
preferences.label: Hide when no timer runs
preferences.description: Only show the menu bar item while a timer is running.

commands.name: create-invoice-draft
commands.title: Create Invoice Draft
commands.subtitle: Folnaro
commands.description: Create an invoice draft for a customer. Folnaro computes totals and VAT.

commands.name: capture-receipt
commands.title: Capture Receipt
commands.subtitle: Folnaro
commands.description: Add the PDF or image selected in Finder to Folnaro's receipt inbox.

commands.name: open-section
commands.title: Open Section
commands.subtitle: Folnaro
commands.description: Jump to a section of Folnaro, like Invoices, Time or Expenses.

preferences.name: language
preferences.title: Language
preferences.description: Language of the extension. Automatic follows your macOS language, like Folnaro.

preferences.name: helperPath
preferences.title: Helper Path
preferences.description: Only if Folnaro is not in Applications: the full path of folnaro-mcp inside Folnaro.app.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
